top_signals.title: Asian Stocks Advance, Crude Oil Holds Decline: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks gained as further evidence of moderating US inflation and a pullback in oil prices reinforced bets that the Federal Reserve will refrain from raising interest rates next month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: From Apple to Ford: How Chinese tech is becoming harder for global companies to ignore
top_signals.summary: Global companies are increasingly tapping Chinese technology for its growing capabilities and scale, even as geopolitical risks remain.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
